note.zh-TW: 網站補充的延伸科目，老師的模板沒有這一列；不列入期中考範圍。
note.en: An extension account added by the site; the teacher's template has no such line and it is outside the mid-term scope.

definition.zh-TW: 先付了錢、服務或權利還沒用到的部分，例如預繳的租金或保險費。它先列為流動資產，隨著時間經過再轉成費用。
definition.en: Payments made before the related service or right has been used, such as rent or insurance paid in advance. It is a current asset first and becomes an expense as time passes.
